chose: Kept SOURCE_COMMIT pinned; did not bump it despite plan §4.1 literally saying to
over: bumping SOURCE_COMMIT to a fresh upstream taxonomy revision and regenerating both JSON files
because: task instructions explicitly override the plan text here: bumping would re-pin to a newer upstream taxonomy, churn lexicon.json for reasons unrelated to this task, and risk the orphan check failing against renamed/removed nodes -- nothing in section 4.1's actual work (capturing vegan/vegetarian/allergens properties, emitting traits.json) needs a taxonomy update. Not bumping keeps traits.json and lexicon.json provably derived from the same revision.

chose: FOOD_TAG_MAP / FoodTag is a 4th trait key (tg), added beyond the plan's literal {vg,vt,al} sketch
over: hand-rolling pork/alcohol/meat-vs-fish detection inline inside the future diet classifier via keyword lists
because: task instructions (mirroring plan section 8.2) call for halal/kosher pork+alcohol exclusion and pescatarian meat-vs-fish distinction, which the taxonomy's ancestor hierarchy already encodes; duplicating that hierarchy as keyword lists inside the classifier would re-derive what traits.json's ancestorUnion walk already computes. One more curated seed map (scripts/food-tags.ts), folded the same way as allergens, avoids that duplication.
